Well, hello!It’s said that past this hole used to be
a huge tower reaching far into the sky.They say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded in the cliff.It was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep down underground!It is rumored that it even reached the
bottom of the ocean!In short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to each other...Most of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are the entrance and its interior, where you’ll see strange patterns.
